name: Section Separator Block – Visually Separate Page Sections
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Section separator block. This block plugin comes up with all the options required to create a professional section separator.

Demos

Features

  • Fully Customizable: All the options you need to arrange the showcase to your liking are available here.

How to use

  • First, install the Section Separator plugin.
  • Add the Section Separator block from the block category called “Widgets” in the Gutenberg editor.
  • You can change block settings from the right-side settings sidebar.

  • Enjoy!

  • For installation help click on Installation Tab

sections.installation:
From Gutenberg Editor:

  1. Go to the WordPress Block/Gutenberg Editor
  2. Search For Section Separator
  3. Click on the Section Separator to add the block

Download & Upload:

  1. Download the Section Separator plugin (.zip file)
  2. In your admin area, go to the Plugins menu and click on Add New
  3. Click on Upload Plugin and choose the separator.zip file and click on Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin and Enjoy!

Manually:

  1. Download and upload the Section Separator plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
sections.faq:
Is Section Separator free?

Yes, Section Separator is a free Gutenberg block plugin.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, it will work with any standard WordPress theme.

Can I change block settings?

Yes, you can change block settings from the Gutenberg block editor’s right sidebar.

How many times can I reuse a block?

You can use unlimited times as you want.

Where can I get support?

You can post your questions on the support forum here
